title: Oil for the lampstand and the bread of the Presence
description: The Lord commands the children of Israel to bring pure, crushed olive oil for the light, so that the lamp may burn continually before the face of the Lord in the tent of meeting, and Aaron shall tend it from evening until morning outside the veil before the testimony. On the pure lampstand the lamps are to be set up at all times. Furthermore, twelve loaves shall be baked from fine flour, each weighing two-tenths of an ephah, and placed in two rows on the pure table, with pure frankincense as a memorial offering and a food offering to the Lord. Every Sabbath day the breads are to be set out before the face of the Lord as a perpetual covenant from the children of Israel, and they belong to Aaron and his sons, who shall eat them in a holy place [ref:3 Mos 24:2-9|Lev 24:2-9].
